title: Java and Python Developer
description:
We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented
**Software Development Engineer (C10)**
with strong hands-on development expertise in both
**Python**
and
**Java**
. In this role, you will be part of a collaborative, high-impact engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing scalable backend services, data pipelines, and microservices supporting mission-critical enterprise platforms.
  
  
As a C10 Applications Development Analyst, you will work across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) under Agile methodologies—participating in requirement analysis, system architecture discussions, hands-on coding, automated testing, code reviews, and production support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Design & Development
* Develop, maintain, and enhance robust, scalable backend applications using Java (Spring Boot / Core Java) and Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django / Scripting / Data Processing).
* Build clean, secure RESTful APIs, microservices, and asynchronous event-driven integrations (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS).
* Optimize application performance, throughput, memory management, and database query execution.
* Quality Assurance & Engineering Best Practices
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code adhering to enterprise coding standards and SOLID principles.
* Develop comprehensive automated unit, integration, and component tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, PyTest, or Unittest.
* Maintain high code coverage and resolve static code analysis findings (e.g., SonarQube, security vulnerabilities).
* CI/CD & DevOps Automation
* Integrate applications with modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Tekton, Harness).
* Containerize services using Docker and support deployments onto container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift).
* Participate in environment setup, automated deployment validation, and release management.
* Collaboration & Agile Delivery
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with business analysts, technical leads, UI/Frontend engineers, database administrators, and QA teams.
* Conduct constructive peer code reviews and contribute to technical documentation (architecture diagrams, API specs in OpenAPI/Swagger).
* Production Support & Operational Excellence
* Assist in triage, root cause analysis (RCA), and remediation of Level 3 production issues.
* Monitor application health and diagnostics using observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry).

**Technical Qualifications & Skill Requirements**
**Core Programming & Frameworks**

* Python: Strong proficiency in Python 3.x, data structures, asynchronous programming, scripting, and web frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or Django) or data manipulation libraries (Pandas, NumPy).
* Java: Solid foundational knowledge of Java 11/17+, OOP design patterns, multithreading, concurrency, collections, and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security).

**API & Integration**

* Practical experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
* Familiarity with message brokers and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, ActiveMQ, or IBM MQ).

**Databases & Persistence**

* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL), including schema design, indexing, and complex SQL queries.
* Exposure to ORM frameworks (Hibernate/JPA, SQLAlchemy) and/or NoSQL datastores (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch).

**DevOps, Cloud & Tooling**

* Hands-on experience with version control tools (Git / GitHub / Bitbucket).
* Familiarity with build tools such as Maven / Gradle (Java) and pip / poetry / uv (Python).
* Basic understanding of Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and cloud fundamentals (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks (JUnit, PyTest) and CI/CD tools.

**Educational Background & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience: Approximately 2-4 years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrable proficiency in both Python and Java.
* Certifications (Optional / Plus):

+ Oracle Certified Professional: Java Programmer
+ Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/Developer Associate, Google Cloud Certified)
+ Kubernetes certifications (CKAD)

**Professional & Behavioral Competencies**

+ Analytical Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking skills with an ability to debug complex issues across hybrid Java/Python architectures.
+ Communication: Clear verbal and written technical communication skills; comfortable articulating design trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ Teamwork & Ownership: Self-driven, collaborative mindset with an emphasis on accountability, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

**Education:**

+ Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

Join a pioneering team at the forefront of financial technology innovation. We are building a cutting-edge, agentic AI platform designed to revolutionize the end-to-end credit risk model development lifecycle. By leveraging the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent workflows, we aim to augment our quantitative modelers, dramatically increasing their productivity, enhancing model governance, and accelerating the delivery of critical risk models.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on senior engineer to be a key contributor to this transformation. In this role, you will work closely with quantitative analysts and key stakeholders to understand and shape high-impact use cases and collaborate within a talented engineering team to design, build, and deploy the generative AI platform that brings this vision to life.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Take end-to-end ownership of discrete platform modules and drive them to completion, exercising sound judgement and initiative to navigate ambiguity and drive progress independently, with minimal supervision.
* Build proofs-of-concept and working prototypes to validate technical approaches early, iterating quickly based on stakeholder feedback in a fast-moving, discovery-driven environment.
* Design, develop, and ship production-grade Python components for the agentic AI platform — orchestration pipelines, RAG systems, LLM integrations, and MCP-based tool interfaces.
* Champion engineering best practices — clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, and monitoring
* Build and maintain secure integrations with internal data sources, external APIs, and LLM providers in compliance with Citi's data governance and security standards
* Actively invest in self-learning to keep pace with the rapidly evolving GenAI and LLM landscape, bringing emerging tools and techniques to the team.

**Qualifications**
: Graduate
  
  
**Must-Haves:**

* Extensive Software Engineering Experience: 8-12 years of hands-on experience designing, building, and shipping complex, scalable software systems to production.
* Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in Python and its ecosystem of libraries for backend development and data processing.
* Generative AI Knowledge : An appetite to learn and apply GenAI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, and MCP, and agentic platforms such as Google ADK, with some evidence of prior exploration in these areas being a plus.
* Backend & Systems Fundamentals: Hands-on experience with REST APIs, SQL/databases, and Unix-based as well as containerized environments
* Technical Influence: Demonstrated ability to contribute to technical direction and champion best practices within an engineering team.
* Excellent Communication: Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to translate business needs into concrete technical requirements.
* Global Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Broader Language Proficiency: Experience with Java/C++ in addition to Python.
* Full-Stack Experience: Familiarity with front-end technologies and developing user interfaces for technical workflows.
* Financial Domain Knowledge: Experience in the financial services industry, particularly in the context of quantitative finance, risk management, or Model Risk Management (MRM).
* Familiarity with Model Development: Understanding of the market and/or credit risk model development lifecycle (e.g., for PD, LGD, EAD models) and associated regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 11-7, CCAR, CECL, etc.).
* Regulated Environments: Experience building auditable and compliant software within a highly regulated environment.

description:

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience.
  
  
We are a certified B Corp that formed in the US in 2016 and have been growing globally since then. We expanded to Australia in 2022, acquired Solar Service Guys in Australia in 2025, and have opened up a new talent hub in India in 2026. Be part of the "First Wave" experience! You would be a founding member of our India team, helping us build a brand-new hub from the ground up.
  
  
****The Job****
As a Software Engineer on the Performance and Financial Products team, you will be a full-time coder focused on implementing features, building and maintaining Java full-stack components, and contributing to Databricks data pipelines. You will use Claude extensively for all coding needs and integration testing under the guidance of Senior and Principal engineers.
  
  
This is a hands-on implementation role with growing ownership of well-scoped work. You will collaborate closely with the broader Engineering, Product, and Data Management teams.

**Software & Data Engineering (80%)**

* Implement features and bug fixes in our Java full-stack codebase (Spring Boot backend + modern front-end)
* Contribute to Databricks data pipelines and supporting Python scripts/components
* Write clean, well-tested code and use Claude daily for code generation, refactoring, debugging, and creating integration tests
* Participate in code reviews and follow team standards for quality, security, and documentation
* Debug issues and help improve system reliability and developer experience

**Collaboration & Learning (15%)**

* Participate in agile ceremonies, estimate work, and communicate progress
* Work with Senior/Principal engineers on design and larger features
* Learn and apply best practices for using Claude effectively and safely

**Continuous Improvement (5%)**

* Suggest and help implement small improvements to code, tests, or processes.

* You are a solid software engineer who enjoys writing high-quality code, learning new systems, and using modern AI tools like Claude to move faster and produce better results.
* You communicate clearly, treat teammates with respect, and are eager to grow in a Java + Databricks environment

* 2-6 years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent strong project/internship background)
* Working proficiency in Java and Spring Boot (or strong willingness to ramp quickly in a Java full-stack shop)
* Experience contributing to full-stack applications and writing SQL
* Familiarity with data pipelines or analytical systems; exposure to Databricks, Spark, or similar is a strong plus
* Comfort writing tests and working in modern development workflows
* Enthusiasm and readiness to use Claude as a primary tool for coding and integration testing every day

**Experience That's a Plus**

* Any hands-on Python experience
* Prior work with Databricks, Delta Lake, or cloud data platforms
* Previous use of Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants

* Interest in data insights, financial/performance products, or the solar industry

title: Applied Scientist II, Last Mile Science
description:
**Description**
Amazon’s Last Mile Team is looking for a passionate individual with strong optimization and analytical skills to join its Last Mile Science team in the endeavor of designing and improving the most complex planning of delivery network in the world. Last Mile builds global solutions that enable Amazon to attract an elastic supply of drivers, companies, and assets needed to deliver Amazon's and other shippers' volumes at the lowest cost and with the best customer delivery experience. Last Mile Science team owns the core decision models in the space of jurisdiction planning, delivery channel and modes network design, capacity planning for on the road and at delivery stations, routing inputs estimation and optimization. Our research has direct impact on customer experience, driver and station associate experience, Delivery Service Partner (DSP)’s success and the sustainable growth of Amazon. Optimizing the last mile delivery requires deep understanding of transportation, supply chain management, pricing strategies and forecasting. Only through innovative and strategic thinking, we will make the right capital investments in technology, assets and infrastructures that allows for long-term success. Our team members have an opportunity to be on the forefront of supply chain thought leadership by working on some of the most difficult problems in the industry with some of the best product managers, scientists, and software engineers in the industry.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Candidates will be responsible for developing solutions to better manage and optimize delivery capacity in the last mile network. The successful candidate should have solid research experience in one or more technical areas of Operations Research or Machine Learning. These positions will focus on identifying and analyzing opportunities to improve existing algorithms and also on optimizing the system policies across the management of external delivery service providers and internal planning strategies. They require superior logical thinkers who are able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems, turn high-level business requirements into mathematical models, identify the right solution approach, and contribute to the software development for production systems. To support their proposals, candidates should be able to independently mine and analyze data, and be able to use any necessary programming and statistical analysis software to do so. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments, which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, and align research focuses with the Amazon's strategic needs. As a senior scientist, you will also help coach/mentor junior scientists in the team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering- SDET
description:
**Job Description**
When you mentor and advise multiple technical teams and move financial technologies forward, it's a big challenge with big impact. You were made for this.
  
  
As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank, Payments Technology, you serve in a leadership role by providing technical coaching and advisory for multiple technical teams, as well as anticipate the needs and potential dependencies of other functions within the firm. As an expert in your field, your insights influence budget and technical considerations to advance operational efficiencies and functionalities.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines and own the enterprise test automation and quality engineering strategy, aligning with broader engineering and business objectives. Scales and mentor global Quality organization across APAC, LATAM, fostering a “shift Left” culture where quality is shared engineering responsibility
* Provides hands-on technical leadership in designing scalable automation frameworks using Rest Assured (API) and Playwright (UI/E2E), setting standards and best practices across teams.
* Drives the performance engineering roadmap — load, stress, scalability, and resilience testing — using tools such as JMeter, Blazemeter, Gremlin ensuring systems meet enterprise SLAs.
* Drives adoption of AI/GenAI-powered testing practices across the organization (AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, intelligent defect triage, predictive quality analytics) to improve engineering velocity and reduce manual effort.
* Deploys advanced synthetic testing to detect issues and latencies in before they impact a single customer in production.
* Partners with senior engineering, product, and business leadership to embed quality and testability into the SDLC from design through production (shift-left/shift-right practices).
* Establishes and report on quality metrics, KPIs, and executive dashboards (defect escape rate, automation coverage, MTTR, performance benchmarks) to senior stakeholders.
* Champions CI/CD-integrated testing practices, ensuring fast, reliable feedback loops across the release pipeline.
* Acts as an escalation point and technical authority for complex production performance issues and quality risk assessments.
* Sets and scales operating practices for enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering and SDLC/TLM automation across multiple teams to improve delivery speed, quality, and operational outcomes; establishes measurable expectations (e.g., throughput, defect reduction, reliability) and ensures consistent validation, security, resiliency, and reuse of proven patterns.

Vice President – Senior Fenergo Technical Configurator
  
  
**Department:**
Client Lifecycle Management & KYC Technology (KYCX)

Platform Configuration & Technical Functional Architecture
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor (Technical SME / Principal Configurator)

12–16 Years (Banking & Financial Services)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a senior, hands-on
**Fenergo Technical Configurator**
at the Vice President level to lead the end-to-end functional platform configuration across our global KYCX (Know Your Customer / Client Experience) estate.
  
  
This is a senior
**Individual Contributor**
role. You will be responsible for the technical configuration design and hands-on implementation of client journeys, policy rule sets, dynamic document models, risk rating logic, and security entitlements within Fenergo CLM. The position requires a deep technical understanding of Fenergo's declarative framework, data model, and workflow engine to translate complex institutional compliance requirements into scalable, maintainable platform configurations without writing custom application code.
  
  
Core Accountabilities
  
  

* Journey & Workflow Engine Configuration
* Own the technical design, configuration, and end-to-end testing of complex client lifecycle journeys across Corporate, Institutional, and Commercial Banking lines of business.
* Build and maintain workflows for Net-New Onboarding, Periodic KYC Refreshes, Event-Driven/Triggered Reviews, Material Change Ingestion, and Offboarding.
* Configure dynamic stage-gates, milestone triggers, complex decision splits, task orchestration, operational handoffs, and parallel processing branches.
* Implement SLA trackers, escalation paths, and automated fallback/exception handling mechanisms across jurisdictional booking locations.
* Policy, Risk & Regulatory Rules Setup
* Configure and maintain the Fenergo Policy Manager, Regulatory Rule Engine, and Entity Requirement Matrices across major regimes (e.g., FinCEN CDD, FATCA/CRS, EU 5MLD/6MLD, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS, HKMA, FCA).
* Set up dynamic Document Requirement Matrices, conditional document triggers, and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculation rules based on entity types, ownership thresholds, and control structures.
* Configure risk scoring criteria, automated SDD/CDD/EDD triggers, and integration points for screening triggers (Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media).
* Entitlements, Security & Data Visibility
* Design and configure granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), functional permission sets, user profiles, and multi-tier approval hierarchies.
* Configure strict data segregation and entitlement rules to enforce cross-border data privacy constraints and regional booking center restrictions.
* Implement Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes principle) controls, operational segregation of duties (SoD), and compliance sign-off stage-gates.
* Data Modeling, UI Forms & Business Rules
* Configure entity data models, complex multi-tier parent-subsidiary hierarchies, fund structures, authorized signers, and related parties in Fenergo.
* Build dynamic, conditional UI forms, custom data groups, dropdown hierarchies, and field-level validation rules.
* Configure data validation rules, format masking, and conditional visibility logic across various stages of the client journey.
* Technical Governance, Packaging & Releases
* Manage configuration asset version control, configuration deltas, XML/JSON deployment packages, and migration scripts across Dev, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.
* Perform pre-release impact assessments for Fenergo core upgrades, service packs, and policy changes to ensure backward compatibility and prevent configuration regressions.
* Troubleshoot advanced configuration defects, data structure inconsistencies, and journey bottlenecks in production and pre-production environments.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have Technical Expertise (Mandatory)
  
  

* Banking & Domain Background: 12 to 15 years of solid experience in Corporate/Investment Banking or Wholesale Financial Services, with deep exposure to KYC/AML, Client Onboarding, Due Diligence (CDD/EDD), and regulatory compliance operations.
* Senior Fenergo Hands-On Experience: Demonstrable, in-depth configuration experience on enterprise Fenergo CLM platforms (v8.x, v9.x, and/or SaaS/Cloud editions).
* Fenergo Journey & Workflow Mastery: Extensive track record building and debugging complex, multi-entity journeys, stage-gates, parallel branches, and exception routing rules.
* Policy Engine & Rules Configuration: Proven hands-on capability in configuring Fenergo Policy Manager, Entity Requirements Matrix, Dynamic Document Engine, and UBO threshold rules.
* Entitlement & Access Model Setup: Direct experience configuring complex user roles, permissions, data-level visibility rules, and cross-jurisdictional entitlement frameworks.
* Entity Data Modeling: Deep expertise in configuring Fenergo data dictionaries, custom attributes, entity relationship mapping, and dynamic UI forms.
* Environment & Package Management: Hands-on experience preparing configuration packages, managing environment-specific variables, and executing zero-downtime configuration deployments across multi-tier environments.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**

* Fenergo Certification: Fenergo Certified Product/Configuration Professional.
* API & Interface Payload Understanding: Strong functional familiarity with REST API / JSON / XML payload structures and data mapping dictionaries for integrating Fenergo with external screening engines (e.g., Fircosoft, World-Check), Core Banking, and Document Repositories.
* External Data Provider Integration: Experience configuring data enrichment lookups and connectors (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk/Orbis, Companies House, Refinitiv, GLEIF).
* Industry Compliance Certifications: ACAMS (CAMS) or ICA Diploma in AML/KYC.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in JIRA/Confluence within a Scrum/SAFe technical delivery model.

Scope & Non-Requirements
  
  

* Individual Contributor Scope: This is a dedicated technical and functional configuration role with no line management or people management responsibilities. The candidate will own technical deliverables, solution designs, and platform setup directly.
* No Software Coding Required: This role does not require software engineering or programming background (such as Java, C#, C++, Python, or web UI development). The focus is entirely on declarative platform configuration, rules engine authoring, data modeling, and workflow orchestration using Fenergo native configuration tools.
